dct_title_s: Eastern Archipelago. : Lombok to Flores including Paternoster and Postillon Islands
dct_description_sm: From Netherlands Government surveys to 1920 ; Published July., 1924, at the Hydrographic Office, under the authority of the Secretary of the Navy.
Depths shown by soundings, relief by form lines and spot heights.
Conversion Table, "Currents" text, Tidal Information, Authorities.
Soundings are in fathoms, heights in feet.
Shows depths, low water, shoals, islands, peaks.
